title: Chapter 306 Seven-Star Arms
content:
Chapter 306 Seven-Star Arms

Without the strong lobbying of the Naga tribe, the Goblins would not necessarily use the right to appeal as a super tribe if the Zerg tribe had not been lobbying vigorously. It was precisely because of the many Zerg information provided by the Naga tribe that the Goblins’ determination was strengthened.

The Zerg tribe was finally able to obtain the special quota for the status of a great tribe, and both the Goblins and the Naga tribes had made great contributions.

Wu Qing never treated those who helped him badly. Now that the Naga tribe was allowed to participate in the war, it was equivalent to giving the Naga tribe benefits for free.

As long as the Zerg tribe defeated the desert race in this war, the participating Naga tribe would gain benefits far exceeding those gained by opening up a new battlefield.

"Of course we will participate!"

Naga answered very straightforwardly.

When the Zerg dared to use the special quota for the status of a great tribe, the Naga tribe knew that they, as an old great tribe, were far inferior to the Zerg, and they would need to cling to the Zerg in the future.

Now that the Zerg has given them such a good opportunity, the Naga tribe must seize it. Perhaps this is the opportunity for the Naga tribe to take off.

All the elite troops in the desert main city of the Naga tribe came out, including more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers, and nearly 10 million troops followed the guidance of the Zerg and marched at full speed to the battlefield of the final decisive battle.

When the Naga army finally joined the Zerg front-line army after a difficult march, Wu Qing’s five new standard Zerg air forces formed in the third Zerg sub-base in the desert battlefield also came to join.

Another five standard Zerg air forces joined, doubling the strength of the Zerg air force to more than 5 million.

Among them are 100,000 five-star Zerg air guards, 100,000 five-star Zerg devourers, 100 six-star Zerg queens, 100 six-star Zerg scorpions, 100 six-star Zerg mammoths and 5 million Zerg flying dragons.

This is a huge resource consumption, but these resources cannot be saved. Wu Qing increased the troops based on the real-time intelligence of the core army of the desert race.

During the march of the core army of the desert race, high-star soldiers from various desert races continued to join. Among them, the strength of the five-star soldiers reached hundreds of thousands, and there were also many six-star soldiers. Even the seven-star soldiers that would not participate in this kind of war appeared.

The strength of this world has reached seven stars, and each one is a strong man. In this world where the rules are already chaotic, they can already slightly shake the rules of the world, easily use various energies between heaven and earth, and exert powerful combat power.

Because of this, the seven-star soldiers have been classified as strong in this world, and their lethality has been leapfrogged compared to the six-star soldiers.

The rules of this world are very strict in limiting the strength of the creatures in this world. It is very difficult for the six-star strength to be upgraded to the seven-star. In general, among the big clans, even if they have the blessing of the status and authority of the big clan, there are not many people who can break through the six-star and upgrade to the seven-star strength.

This highlights the preciousness of the seven-star soldiers. They are the real foundation of various races, not to mention the real strong ones whose strength exceeds the seven-star.

Therefore, in the faction war in this world, both sides tacitly agreed to the rule that seven-star soldiers do not participate in ordinary wars.

This knowledge is recorded in the latest information given to Wu Qing by the goblin elder Gong Rui. Now the Zerg army needs to really face this level of enemy, Wu Qing took it out again and took a closer look.

"The seven-star strength in this world already has the ability of the tenth-level strength in the normal world, and can be regarded as an extremely weak version of the tenth-level strong!"

"No wonder everyone treats them as treasures. If the seven-star soldiers cannot be suppressed at the beginning and let them play their strength, the Zerg army will also suffer heavy losses!"

"The best way to deal with seven-star soldiers is to strike first and prevent them from taking action!"

Wu Qing is going to start with the seven-star strongmen in the core army of the desert race.

This is not only to reduce the losses of the Zerg army, but Wu Qing also needs to upgrade the Zerg hive by killing seven-star enemies.

When the Zerg hive is upgraded to seven stars, the Zerg will add seven-star soldiers, and it will have the strength of a real big clan.

The Zerg host has discovered less than a hundred seven-star desert race warriors, but they can mobilize the energy of heaven and earth, such as instant large-scale battlefield magic, single-handedly entering the enemy camp, beheading the general and seizing the flag, and such things are possible.

However, the Zerg has a hundred six-star Zerg queens and a hundred six-star Zerg scorpions, and those seven-star desert race warriors may hardly have a chance to attack.

…

Naga was riding a strange chariot at this time, flying beside the host No. 3, staring at the battlefield in the distance.

Above the vast desert, the dark Zerg army has covered the yellow sand of the desert. Opposite the Zerg army are the colorful armies of various desert races.

The armies of both sides kept fighting cruelly on the front line. The powerful Zerg puppies in close combat and the powerful three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions with long-range attacks worked together to fight against the various desert race armies.

Soldiers of both armies continued to die in battle and disappeared in light, and the soldiers of both sides behind them continued to surge up and continue to fight.

In Naga's eyes, the battle line of black and color spread to the sky, with no end in sight.

A large number of Zerg air forces gathered together, not participating in the battle, and were particularly conspicuous.

The number of those huge five-star troops made Naga a little frightened, as she had seen the strength of those powerful Zerg troops.

"I didn't expect that you have invested so many troops, and your tribe is fighting alone in this ancient desert territory. My tribe is inferior to you!"

Naga suddenly spoke to Host No. 3 who was not far away from her.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

Host No. 3 did not respond to this.

"Will Lord Wu Qing personally come to command this decisive battle?"

Naga asked again.

"Lord Lord is on the battlefield fighting with the alien race, he will not come."

Host No. 3 replied.

Host No. 3 can be a virtual personality, it can be the Queen of Insects, or it can be Wu Qing. This is true for every Zerg with strong spiritual power.

At this moment, Host No. 3 is the virtual personality of Host No. 3 himself. The Queen of Insects and Wu Qing's main energy is placed elsewhere.

"Who is the commander of this war? I want to see him!"

Naga continued to ask.

"The one who commands this war is the Queen of Insects! If you can't see the Queen of Insects, if there is anything, I can convey it on your behalf!"

Host No. 3 replied.

The only Zerg people who have independent consciousness now are Wu Qing and the Queen. Everything that Wu Qing doesn't do is done by the Queen.

"It's about this war. In conventional wars, our army can't help much, but in the battle of the strong, our tribe can still contribute!"

"In this newly opened battlefield, there is a high probability that the opponent will let the strong directly participate in the war. We must be prepared!"

Naga reminded.

"The lord has given an order that the noble army does not need to be involved in the battle. If the noble strong want to contribute, please protect the noble army!"

"This battle, our tribe will fight alone and officially start the trial to obtain the status of a great tribe!"

Host No. 3 replied.

Naga was a little unhappy after hearing the first sentence of Host No. 3, but after hearing the second sentence of Host No. 3, she fell silent.

The reason why the Zerg will start the trial to obtain the status of a great tribe is indeed impeccable.

Since the Zerg didn't need the help of the Naga and were ready to win a victory for free, Naga didn't hesitate anymore and was ready to watch the battle quietly.

...

A special line of soldiers appeared along the distant skyline, and slowly pressed towards the battle line between the two sides.

The core army of the desert race finally arrived.

Naga, who was standing on a high chariot watching the battle, could only see a part of the core army of the desert race with hundreds of millions of soldiers. More troops were out of her sight.

Naga had never seen a war of this scale and level.

The Zerg air force, which had been silent, began to move. One hundred thousand five-star Zerg air guards rose to high altitudes, ready to launch a long-range attack beyond visual range.

A group of five-star transport Zerg hosts each built a platform with their tentacles and placed one hundred six-star Zerg scorpions on the platform they built.

One hundred six-star Zerg queens flew into the Zerg flying dragon group.

One hundred thousand five-star Zerg Devourers, in conjunction with five million Zerg Dragons, built up the anti-air power of the Zerg air force.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

One hundred thousand five-star Zerg Air Guards opened fire first.

Under the guidance of the Zerg host, they used the high-altitude beyond-visual-range range to accurately aim at the five-star troops in the core army of the Desert Race and opened fire.

As the ultimate Zerg troop, the Zerg Air Guards can exert the combat power of six-star troops with five-star strength. Their attacks cannot withstand the five-star troops in the Desert Race army.

The five-star Zerg Air Guards only used the coverage attack mode to attack, and some of the five-star troops with weaker defense in the Desert Race army were severely damaged, resulting in a large number of casualties.

Even the five-star troops with strong defense capabilities were in a mess under the attack of the five-star Zerg Air Guards.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

The Zerg Air Guards attacked very quickly, and the second round of attacks followed closely.

The core army of the desert race had no way to counterattack in the face of such a long-range attack. Even if those seven-star strongmen attacked, they could not reach the Zerg army at this distance.

They could only watch the five-star troops of the desert race army continue to lose.

"All troops, speed up the advance!"

"Now is not the time to talk about the rules. Let them all attack and destroy those troops that hit the farthest first!"

A powerful desert lizardman in the core army of the desert race opened his mouth and ordered.

The core army of the desert race changed its leisurely marching speed and began to speed up its advance.

The nearly one hundred seven-star strongmen of the desert races of various tribes used their own methods to rush out of the formation and rushed towards the direction of the Zerg army.
